heads.en: T-reading/TVBS published the Ten Commandments of the Trump University Strategy, which analyzes power codes. The TVBS was published today (26th) with the participation of the Institute of International Affairs and Strategic Strategies of the University of Jiangjiang in a new book conference entitled "The Ten Commandments of Trump: New Horizons to Decode Politics and Power after the Mid-Term Elections".
